# IGotAnOffer

> > The leading 1-on-1 coaching platform connecting job seekers with expert coaches for interview prep, career transitions, and salary negotiation.

IGotAnOffer is a comprehensive coaching marketplace specializing in helping professionals succeed in interviews and advance their careers. The platform offers personalized coaching across multiple disciplines including software engineering, product management, consulting, and leadership roles at top tech and finance companies.

## Core Coaching Services

- [Interview Coaching Service](https://igotanoffer.com/en/interview-coaching): Expert interview coaching for tech, PM, and consulting roles at top companies
- [Career Coaching Service](https://igotanoffer.com/en/career-coaching): 1-on-1 career coaching for transitions, clarity, and next steps
- [Salary Negotiation Coaching](https://igotanoffer.com/en/salary-negotiation-service): Expert salary negotiation coaching to increase compensation
- [Leadership Coaching Service](https://igotanoffer.com/en/leadership-coaching): Leadership coaching to get promoted and advance your career
- [Resume Review Service](https://igotanoffer.com/en/resume-service): Professional resume review service for tech, consulting, and PM careers
- [Mentoring Platform](https://igotanoffer.com/en/mentors): Mentoring platform for skill development and career goal achievement
